newsitem.title: USA: Valero to redeem $3.125 convertible pfd shrs.
newsitem.headline: Valero to redeem $3.125 convertible pfd shrs.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp said Friday it had called for redemption on June 2 its $3.125 convertible preferred stock.
The redemption price is $52.188 per share, plus accrued dividends in the amount of $0.0086 per share, the company said.

The preferred stock is convertible into Valero common stock at a conversion price of $27.03 per share, equivalent to a conversion rate of about 1.85 shares of common stock for each share of convertible preferred.
Holders of the preferred stock have until the close of business May 23 to convert their shares into common, Valero said.
